cart.item_count.message: {count, plural, =0 {Your cart is empty} one {# item} other {# items}}
cart.item_count.comment: Cart summary line in the header. The zero case is written with =0 rather than a zero category, because English has no CLDR zero form.

order.mixed_plural.message: Ship {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} to {city} by {when, date, medium}
order.mixed_plural.comment: Shipping confirmation. A plural sitting alongside other arguments, which is the case native formats struggle with.

order.nested.message: {status, select, shipped {{count, plural, one {# parcel is} other {# parcels are}} on the way} pending {Waiting on payment} other {Something went wrong}}
order.nested.comment: Order status line. A plural nested inside a select, to prove nesting survives every transform.

status.desc: One of shipped, pending, or anything else.

leaderboard.rank.message: You finished {place, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}
leaderboard.rank.comment: Result line after a race. Ordinal plurals, which several export formats cannot represent at all.

chat.others.message: {name} and {count, plural, offset:1 one {# other} other {# others}} replied
chat.others.comment: Thread summary. Uses a plural offset so the named person is not counted twice.

count.desc: Total repliers, including the named one.

legal.terms.message: Read the terms of service and our privacy notice
legal.terms.comment: Footer line. Rich-text tags become render hooks the caller supplies.

profile.repeat.comment: Invite banner. The same argument twice, which positional formats must map to one index.

device.sent_to.comment: Confirmation toast. The device name is user-chosen and can be in any script, which is what makes bidi isolation matter.

nav.save.comment: Toolbar button. Imperative, and short enough that translations will run well past it.

marketing.headline.comment: Landing page hero. Rewrite for local readability rather than translating word for word.

seo.home_title.message: Send browser tabs between your devices instantly
seo.home_title.comment: Home page title tag. Keep the primary keyword prominent and stay under the length limit.

billing.receipt.comment: Receipt line. Number and date skeletons are formatted by the runtime, not baked into the catalog.
